events.title: Remembering Tupac Shakur
events.blurb: On this day in 1996, influential rapper Tupac Shakur was tragically shot in Las Vegas, passing away six days later.

angles.name: Tupac's Legacy
angles.copy: Thirty years ago, the music world lost a true icon. Remembering the unparalleled impact of Tupac Shakur today.

events.title: Remembering Jimi Hendrix
events.blurb: We mark the anniversary of the passing of legendary guitarist Jimi Hendrix, who died in 1970.

angles.name: Hendrix Tribute
angles.copy: The world lost a guitar hero on this day. Remembering the incredible talent and enduring legacy of Jimi Hendrix.

events.title: The Beatles' Abbey Road Anniversary
events.blurb: The iconic Beatles album 'Abbey Road' was released on this day in 1969.

angles.name: Abbey Road Classic
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years ago, The Beatles gave us 'Abbey Road'. What's your favourite track from this legendary album?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Wishing a very happy 75th birthday to The Pretenders' legendary frontwoman, Chrissie Hynde, born in 1951.

angles.name: Chrissie Hynde Bday
angles.copy: Happy 75th to the one and only Chrissie Hynde! Still rocking as hard as ever.

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Wishing a very happy 54th birthday to the iconic Oasis frontman, Liam Gallagher, born in 1972.

angles.name: Liam G Bday
angles.copy: Happy 54th to the one and only Liam Gallagher! Still bringing the swagger to British music.

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' Anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon's powerful anthem 'Imagine' was released on this day in 1975.

angles.name: Imagine Release
angles.copy: Fifty-one years since John Lennon released 'Imagine'. A timeless message that resonates just as strongly today.

events.title: The Original iPod's Anniversary
events.blurb: On this day in 2001, Apple introduced the world to the very first iPod.

angles.name: iPod Nostalgia
angles.copy: Remember the first time you saw one of these? The original iPod changed how we listened to music, 25 years ago today.

events.title: Happy James Bond Day!
events.blurb: Today marks James Bond Day, celebrating the iconic film franchise.

angles.name: Bond Day
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! Who's your favourite Bond and what's the ultimate Bond theme tune?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Remembering John Lennon, who would have celebrated his 86th birthday today, born in 1940.

angles.name: Lennon Tribute Bday
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we remember the unparalleled talent and vision of John Lennon.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the legendary comedian and actor John Cleese, born in 1939.

angles.name: John Cleese Bday
angles.copy: Happy 87th birthday to the one and only John Cleese! A true titan of British comedy.

events.title: The Beatles' White Album Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their self-titled double album, commonly known as 'The White Album,' on this day in 1968.

angles.name: White Album Classic
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years ago, The Beatles unleashed 'The White Album'. A sprawling masterpiece – what are your standout tracks?

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: We mark the anniversary of the tragic passing of Queen's iconic frontman, Freddie Mercury, who died in 1991.

angles.name: Freddie Tribute
angles.copy: Thirty-five years ago, the music world lost a legend. Remembering the one and only Freddie Mercury today.

events.title: The Beatles' Rubber Soul Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles' classic album 'Rubber Soul' was released on this day in 1965.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Classic
angles.copy: Sixty-one years since The Beatles delivered 'Rubber Soul'. Still sounds as fresh and innovative as ever.

events.title: Remembering John Lennon
events.blurb: We remember the tragic passing of music icon John Lennon on this day in 1980.

angles.name: Lennon Death Tribute
angles.copy: Forty-six years ago, the world lost a voice of peace and a musical visionary. Remembering John Lennon today.
